items.source: Remove the application context for the supplied MergedContextConfiguration from the ContextCache and close it if it is an instance of ConfigurableApplicationContext.
items.translation: 从ContextCache中移除为提供的MergedContextConfiguration创建的application context，如果它是ConfigurableApplicationContext的实例，则调用其close()方法。

items.source: Mark the application context of the supplied test context as dirty and set REINJECT_DEPENDENCIES_ATTRIBUTE in the test context to true.
items.translation: 将提供的application context的test context标记为dirty，并将测试上下文中的REINJECT_DEPENDENCIES_ATTRIBUTE设置为true。

items.source: Defines modes which determine how the context cache is cleared when @DirtiesContext is used in a test whose context is configured as part of a hierarchy via @ContextHierarchy.
items.translation: 定义modes，以确定在使用@DirtiesContext且上下文通过@ContextHierarchy配置为层次结构一部分的测试中清除上下文缓存的方式。

items.source: Call this method to signal that the application context associated with this test context is dirty and should be removed from the context cache.
items.translation: 调用此方法以标记与此测试上下文关联的应用上下文为脏状态，并应从上下文缓存中移除。

items.source: Remove the context with the given key from the cache and explicitly close it if it is an instance of ConfigurableApplicationContext.
items.translation: 从缓存中移除具有给定键的上下文，如果它是 `ConfigurableApplicationContext` 的实例，则显式关闭它。

items.source: Mark the application context associated with this test context as dirty (i.e., by removing it from the context cache and closing it).
items.translation: 将此测试上下文关联的application context标记为dirty（即，将其从上下文缓存中移除并关闭）。

items.source: Uses of DirtiesContext.HierarchyMode in org.springframework.test.annotation
Uses of DirtiesContext.HierarchyMode in org.springframework.test.context
items.translation: `org.springframework.test.context` 中 `DirtiesContext.HierarchyMode` 的用法

items.source: Uses of DirtiesContext.HierarchyMode in org.springframework.test.context.cache
Uses of DirtiesContext.HierarchyMode in org.springframework.test.context.support
This package contains the Spring TestContext Framework which provides annotation-driven unit and integration testing support that is agnostic of the actual testing framework in use.
items.translation: 该包包含Spring TestContext 框架，它提供与所使用的实际测试框架无关的基于注解的单元测试和集成测试支持。

items.source: Support for context caching within the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: 支持在Spring TestContext Framework中的上下文缓存。

items.source: Support classes for the Spring TestContext Framework.

items.translation: 支持注解驱动测试的支持类。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name.
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。

items.source:
Returns an array containing the constants of this enum class, in
the order they are declared.
items.translation: 返回一个包含此枚举类常量的数组，按声明顺序排列。
